page.title: Customer driving licences
page.subtitle: Review licence submissions the system could not verify automatically. Customers can book self-drive vehicles as soon as their licence is verified.
page.loadError: Could not load the licence list.
page.emptyPending: No submissions are waiting for review.

filters.searchPlaceholder: Name, licence number, account name or phone

image.title: Front photo
image.alt: Licence photo submitted by the customer
image.zoomHint: Click the photo to zoom in.

form.title: Verified details
form.hint: Check each field against the photo, correct any misread value, then click Verify.
form.classesHelp: Separate classes with commas, e.g. A1, B2
form.issuingCountry: Issued in (2-letter country code, e.g. US)

errors.fullName: Enter the name on the licence
errors.expiresOn: Enter the expiry date or tick no expiry

reject.title: Reject driving licence
reject.label: Message to the customer
reject.placeholder: e.g. The licence number is covered, please retake the photo.
reject.required: The "other" reason needs a message to the customer
reject.audience: The customer sees this reason and message, then sends another photo.

footer.pending: Check the photo against the details, then decide.
footer.decided: This submission already has an outcome.
